scope: Gift-card restoration after merchant cancellation and COD rejection/timeout
finding: Both route handlers awaited restore_gift_card_on_refund but ignored the returned PostgREST error. A failed restoration therefore had no route-level failure signal.
change: Both handlers now convert a returned RPC error into a sanitized exception caught by their existing best-effort warning path. The verified refund helper already inspected RPC errors.
notEstablished: A route-level injected RPC failure and subsequent durable restoration retry
